assertions.name: registry_triple_consistent
assertions.source: Indicator (1 = |m_e*(m_p/m_e) - m_p| is inside the KNOWN_TRIPLE_RESIDUAL_PPB ceiling). Live residual is ~0.0029 ppb, about a quarter of m_p's last printed digit — the floor any same-edition triple can reach. The defect this guards against was 1.35 ppb, 27x the ceiling, and invisible to every float64/precision audit because nothing about it was imprecise.

assertions.name: ame_neutron_equals_its_definition
assertions.source: Indicator (1 = M_N_MEV_AME_DERIVED - (M_P + M_E + Q_BETA_AME) vanishes to the stored literal's last digit). It is a derived quantity; the old value outlived the 2018 proton it was built from, which is how a 1.5 ppb 'tension between two competing authoritative neutrons' was manufactured. Now 0.16 ppb.

assertions.name: m_p_row_reported_but_not_scored
assertions.source: Indicator (1 = the dashboard marks m_p is_anchor_roundtrip and leaves beats_100x None so it is excluded from the count). q_0 is pinned from m_p/m_e, so m_p_pred == m_e*MASS_RATIO_P_E identically and the residual is CODATA's own rounding. Scoring it would have flipped the headline to 3/7 on a tautology; the count correctly stays 2/7 (AGENTS.md q_0-anchor rule 1).

assertions.name: fix_does_not_explain_mu_p_tension
assertions.source: Indicator (1 = the m_mu miss did NOT improve). It moved 963.6x -> 970.2x, i.e. worse. Recorded as measured rather than suppressed: a correction that degrades an observable is still the correct value. The mu-p substrate tension is genuine.

assertions.name: qbeta_miss_survives_the_fix
assertions.source: Indicator (1 = Q_beta still misses its 100x target). It does, at 164x. The fix reconciled Q_beta's two experimental determinations (1814 -> 194 ppb, 2.33 -> 0.25 sigma) but left the prediction's residual intact, so Q_beta remains one of the two genuine L2 levers.

description: Regression guard for the CODATA registry vintage straddle fixed on 2026-08-09 (PR #4860). Seven mass literals labelled 'CODATA 2022' held CODATA-2018 values; the ~1.3 ppb straddle was 100% of the m_p row's reported L2 error and contaminated Q_beta's comparison target and the AME-derived neutron. Detected from internal inconsistency alone, then confirmed against RMP 97, 025002. This probe now asserts the corrected state. Audit-only; changes no prediction.

parameters.primary_source: Mohr, Newell, Taylor & Tiesinga, Rev. Mod. Phys. 97, 025002 (2025) — library/revmodphys97025002pdf/RevModPhys.97.025002.pdf.pdf
